searchText: How do proposals on eth magicians and eth research differ? I thought they all appear on eth magicians but seems like they don’t now? They can go anywhere, there just has to be somewhere they can be discussed. yeah, we usually default to eth magicians for EIPs. I actually didn't even notice EIP-5133 used ethresear.ch until after I posted a comment on the thread 😅 Did you get this sorted? If not send me an example (even just a PR with you deleting their comments) and I’ll make a request. I haven't seen them spam in the last couple days, so maybe? No one responded directly. 🤷 Or maybe GitHub finally banned them. Sorry, I don’t monitor these channels. If it happens in the future feel free to ping me. Ty for the answers
